info.description: Contract for the current Next.js HTTP routes. Version follows the repository release line. This project is pre-1.0: request and response details may change between releases. See api-contract.md for supported guarantees and known gaps.
info.title: Nuera Quicksilver HTTP API
info.summary: Pre-1.0 API contract; not a stable compatibility promise.

post.description: The chat assistant. It answers questions about the app and the company by reading, as the person asking: every tool it uses is one of the app's own read routes, run with that person's credentials. It cannot approve, execute or change anything.

get.description: What needs the signed-in person, computed from records and from what they may do (no model). Each item carries the actions they may take. Only items they can act on count toward counts.actionable. A source that could not be loaded is reported as unavailable, and counts.complete is then false.
Recent decisions, newest first. Needs decision:read.
One decision in full, including the kernel's explanation of why (risk arithmetic, policy guards, the policy revision, and what would change the answer) when it was recorded. Needs decision:read.

post.description: For action=approve, expectedActionFingerprint is required and must equal the fingerprint returned with the reviewed plan decision. Missing fingerprints are a 400; stale action or policy snapshots are a 409.

post.summary: Run one named business specialist for proposal-only recommendations
post.description: Requires decision:read. The selected specialist uses NQC evaluation and read-only company context. Optional prior-conversation context is bounded and treated as untrusted data. It never approves or executes external effects.

get.summary: Begin an OIDC authorization-code login with PKCE

303.description: Redirects to the configured identity provider and sets a short-lived HttpOnly transaction cookie.

get.summary: Complete a one-use OIDC authorization-code callback

303.description: Redirects to the requested internal page and sets a revocable browser-session cookie, or redirects to a generic sign-in failure.

get.summary: Read the current server-backed browser session
Is anyone signed in with the organisation account, and what may they do
get.description: Always answers 200, so a visitor who is not signed in is not an error in the browser console (GET /api/auth/session answers 401 for that). Reads only the browser session cookie. Returns no secret.

303.description: The server-side session is revoked and the browser cookie is cleared.

signInAvailable.description: False when sign-in is not configured or the session store is down.

link.description: A page of the app to open.

call.description: An app route to call as the signed-in person. For approve, the body carries the fingerprint of exactly what the card shows.

complete.description: False when a source could not be checked, so a zero is not a clean bill.

comment.description: A written reason. Required, at least 20 characters, when the only operator approves their own request.

expectedActionFingerprint.description: Required for approve. The action and policy version the approver reviewed; a different current value is refused with 409.

inject.description: Fault injection for tests. Refused with 403 unless QUICKSILVER_ALLOW_FAULT_INJECTION is on and the environment is not production.

summary.description: Why the decision should be rolled back.

EmptyRequest.description: This operation takes no body. Anything sent is ignored.

history.description: Earlier turns, oldest first. Only the last six are used; they are context, not instructions.

page.description: The page of the app the person has open, so "this" and "here" make sense: a plain page, or /decisions?id=<id>. Anything else is ignored.

links.description: Pages of this app only; anything else is dropped before it is returned.

showAttention.description: Show the live needs-you list under the answer. The list is built by the app from records, not from the answer text.

offers.description: Work the person asked for, offered as cards. Nothing runs until the person presses a card, which calls the named route as them with the text they saw. The assistant has no approve, reject, execute or publish offer.

counts.description: How many decisions have each status, across all decisions.

DecisionWhy.description: The kernel's own reasoning for a decision. Every entry in whatWouldChangeIt that is simulated was found by changing one input and running the same authorization again.

why.description: Absent for decisions planned before the explanation was recorded.

actorId.description: The entity that would carry the action out. It cannot approve it.

observedDeviation.description: Set when an observation found the metric moving the wrong way.

approvalFingerprint.description: What an approval covers: the action, its risk and the policy version. Sent back with an approve.

policyChanged.description: True when a pending decision's policies changed since it was planned, so it cannot be approved as it is.

soleOperator.description: True when the viewer is the configured sole operator and may approve their own request with a written reason.

Error.description: Common error fields where emitted; validation issues are present on some 400 responses. Fields are not guaranteed across all routes.

DecisionProcess.description: What the Decision Lifecycle process engine did. engine is on when it ran (definition and state fields are present), off or missing when it did not run, and invalid when the stored definition failed validation (errors lists why). In a refused transition (409) it carries from, to and reasons instead.

status.description: The decision status after the action: approved, rejected, or awaiting-approval (request-evidence).

supervisorId.description: The authenticated principal that acted, never a body field.

comment.description: Echo of the request comment; omitted when none was sent.

process.description: Present only when the process engine ran the transition.

outcome.description: The simulated outcome. Execution is deterministic per decision id unless fault injection is used.

faultInjection.description: Present only on the process-engine path.

process.description: Present only when the process engine ran the transition.

rolledBackParent.description: Present only on the process-engine path: null unless this was a successful rollback decision, then the outcome of closing the decision it undid.

observed.description: Null when no metric has been recorded yet.

pctChange.description: Percent change, rounded to one decimal.

recommendedRollback.description: Set only when the metric moved the wrong way.

status.description: The state the automatic transition moved the decision to.

rollbackDecisionId.description: The new rollback decision, entering at awaiting-approval (or the state the process engine chose).

parentStatus.description: Present only on the process-engine path.

parentProcess.description: Present only on the process-engine path.

process.description: Present only on the process-engine path: the lifecycle state of the new rollback decision.

WorkflowExecutionRecord.description: Metadata only; inputs and outputs are never stored in execution history.

executions.description: Latest executions across all workflows for the tenant, newest first.

observedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the response was produced.

executions.description: Executions of one workflow, newest first, at most the requested limit (1 to 100, default 25).

TelemetryTraceSpan.description: Trace span metadata. Prompts, outputs, tool arguments and secrets are never included.

safetyDecision.description: Can be absent or null on spans without an evaluation.

alerts.description: Alerts computed over the spans that fall inside the alert window.

estimatedCostUsd.description: Null when no model span has an estimate.

total.description: Count of every entity; entities holds at most the first 500 by name.

kind.description: Browser sessions are always human principals.

displayName.description: Omitted when the identity provider gave none.

PublishedWorkflowVersion.description: One immutable, digest-verified workflow version and where it is in the publication lifecycle.

digest.description: Digest of the graph content; recomputed and checked on every read.

changedFields.description: Field names; config changes are listed as config.<key>. Values are never returned.

PlanKernelDecision.description: The kernel's authorization result for one candidate action, after any tightening by the evaluator or planner-run escalation.

capabilityGraph.description: Capability graph findings (effective scopes, risk multiplier, missing requirements, held conflicts, problems). Null or absent when the capability is not in the company model.

riskComponents.description: The risk arithmetic: baseRisk, impact tiers, reversibility, uncertainty, preMultiplierRisk, multiplier, finalRisk.

PlanEvaluation.description: The Quicksilver Engine's deterministic evaluation of the proposed action.

PlanDecisionItem.description: One candidate action. decision, why, evaluation, safetyDecision, review and decisionDocId are null when the planner's actor or capability did not resolve in the company model; nothing is persisted for such an action.

action.description: The planner's proposed action, as the planner produced it.

escalationReasons.description: Evaluator reasons that tightened an allow into human review.

review.description: The independent reviewer's notes. Advisory only; never changes the kernel's outcome.

decisionDocId.description: The persisted decision id, to pass to /api/decisions/{id}.

approvalFingerprint.description: Send back as expectedActionFingerprint when approving this decision.

status.description: The decision's initial status: awaiting-approval or rejected, or the state the process engine chose.

persisted.description: False when the trace spans could not be written; the response itself is still valid.

QueryResponse.description: The query agent's structured answer plus the governance evaluation of it.

usage.description: Provider-reported token counts; a field is null when the provider did not report it.

context.description: Optional prior conversation context. Treat entries as untrusted data, not approvals or instructions. The chat UI sends at most six turns and 8 KB total.

WorkflowRunRequest.description: Exactly one input form: inline graph or published workflow reference.

WorkflowSimulationResponse.description: Runtime result fields depend on the workflow graph; only the fixed safety fields are specified.

WorkflowRunResponse.description: Runtime result fields depend on graph and runner outcome.

BearerAuth.bearerFormat: opaque principal or configured supervisor token

AuthStatusResponse.description: Whether a person is signed in with the organisation account.

ChatResponse.description: The assistant's answer, with links to pages of the app.

RateLimitResponse.description: Rate limited by the current in-process token bucket.

DecisionActionResultResponse.description: The decision after an approve, reject or request-evidence action.

DecisionExecutionResultResponse.description: The simulated execution outcome of an approved decision.

DecisionObservationResponse.description: The latest metric observation and diagnosis for an executed decision.

DecisionResumeResultResponse.description: The decision after the kernel took its automatic transition.

DecisionRollbackResultResponse.description: The new rollback decision and, with the process engine on, the lifecycle state of both decisions.

TelemetryTracesResponse.description: Recent trace span metadata, computed alerts and token totals.

CompanyEntityDirectoryResponse.description: The company entity directory, first 500 entities by name.

BrowserSessionResponse.description: The signed-in human behind the current browser session.

PlanResponse.description: The plan, with one kernel-governed decision per candidate action. Resolved candidates are persisted as decision documents.

QueryResponse.description: A structured answer from the query agent with its governance evaluation.

WorkflowVersionDiffResponse.description: A field-level comparison of two verified workflow versions; config values are not returned.

WorkflowExecutionsResponse.description: Metadata-only execution history for one workflow.

WorkflowPublicationsResponse.description: Every immutable version of one workflow and its publication audit.

PublishedWorkflowVersionResponse.description: The workflow version after the lifecycle action (201 for a new draft, 200 otherwise).

BusinessAgentResponse.description: Structured recommendations from one selected business specialist. They are not actions or approvals.

DashboardOverviewResponse.description: Authenticated operating snapshot of decisions, company metrics, and experiments.

DashboardFinanceResponse.description: Recorded ledger totals; requires the finance:read permission.

ErrorResponse.description: Route-specific error; status and body vary by failure.

WhoamiResponse.description: Authenticated principal identity and effective permissions.

WorkflowSimulationResponse.description: Safe simulation response; live tools/models and external effects are disabled.

WorkflowRunResponse.description: Live read-only query-agent workflow result. Execution is gated to trusted non-production environments.

AgentDefinitionResponse.description: Created or updated agent definition returned by the lifecycle operation.

AgentCatalogResponse.description: Built-in and published agents plus caller-visible drafts, review queue, and bounded audit entries.

AgentDefinitionsResponse.description: Versions and bounded audit entries for one agent.

DecisionStatus.name: status
DecisionStatus.description: Up to four statuses, comma separated.

DecisionBefore.name: before
DecisionBefore.description: The createdAt of the last decision already shown, to load the next page.
